displayIdentity.body: When Pentecost arrives, a heaven-sent sound fills the house, divided tongues like fire rest on each person, all are filled with the Holy Spirit, and they speak other languages.
displayIdentity.title: Sound, divided fire-like tongues, and other languages fill the gathering
